query: 2020, john x morris, textattack adversarial attacks data and in, emnlp, university of virginia
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue_type,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
  p.year = 2020
  AND p.canonical_venue = 'EMNLP'
  AND p.venue_type = 'main'
  AND a.name ILIKE '%john%morri%'
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%textattack%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%textattack%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%adversarial%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial%'
  )
  AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%university of virginia%'
    OR i.display_name ILIKE '%uva%'
  )
ORDER BY
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
